_doc: Slice registry. One slice = one primary spec prefix + one RFC (or one RFC part). Read by tools/impact.py and by the agents in .claude/agents. See docs/process/pipeline.md.

architecture.owns: components, ownership, principles A1-A11, substrate (§5.5), contracts table (§8), allocation table (§7)

S-LINK.focus: link schedule owner, link registry, holds/tombstones, outages and reductions, offers

S-ACCT.focus: account owner booking part, decision point, partner adapters, status reads

S-RATE.focus: metering ingestion, attribution, quarantine, rating, catalogue

S-MONEY.focus: Part A funds and standing (in the account owner); Part B ledger, payments, payouts, reconciliation

S-SEC.focus: identity and access, tenancy, operator console, audit, personal-data store, encryption

S-PLAT.focus: CockroachDB/Kafka platform, owner leases, clocks, failover, probes, capacity, backups
